note: Hidden helper submodule of graphql_compose. Exposes Drupal layout (Layout Discovery) definitions (Layout type, LayoutSectionItem field, LayoutDefinitionLoad/Property producers) as the shared foundation for the Layout Builder and Layout Paragraphs submodules. It has no per-bundle config key, so medium/hard cases are grounded in the real, restorable schema-provider registration on the server (schema_configuration.graphql_compose.providers.graphql_compose_layouts; baseline: absent). Evals avoid live GraphQL queries and 'drush cr'.

evals.prompt: What does the graphql_compose_layouts submodule expose, and what kind of module is it (visible or hidden)?
evals.expected_output: It is a hidden helper submodule that exposes Drupal layout (Layout Discovery) definitions - a layout plugin's id, label and regions - to the schema, via a Layout SchemaType and layout-definition data producers.

evals.prompt: Which other GraphQL Compose submodules depend on graphql_compose_layouts and why?
evals.expected_output: graphql_compose_layout_builder and graphql_compose_layout_paragraphs depend on it; it provides the shared Layout definition types/producers those submodules attach their concrete section/component data to.

evals.prompt: Name the data producers or schema type graphql_compose_layouts provides for layout definitions.
evals.expected_output: SchemaType Layout, FieldType LayoutSectionItem, and DataProducers LayoutDefinitionLoad and LayoutDefinitionProperty (wired by LayoutSchemaExtension).

evals.prompt: Inspect the GraphQL Compose server configuration (graphql.graphql_servers.graphql_compose_server) and state whether graphql_compose_layouts is currently registered in the schema providers list.

Register graphql_compose_layouts as a GraphQL Compose schema provider on the default server by adding it to schema_configuration.graphql_compose.providers on graphql.graphql_servers.graphql_compose_server. Apply the change to the live configuration.
